messages:
deploy-bot: initiating canary v2026.03.22-rc5 -> 15% traffic. preflight passed. audit id a-1747776543.

ana: SLO dashboard: embed /embeddings p95 spiked from 110ms -> 600ms in eu-central. 5xx at 1.2%. linking chart: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/1747776543

mike: 5xx are 502s from embed-router pool showing backend resets. I see increased queue latency on gpu-host-18 (nvlink chatter).

sara: trace shows `kv_fetch` latency skyrocketed, plus repeated "kernel_missing" warnings in runtime logs for a subset of requests. snippet: ```kernel_missing for model=embed-XL quant=8bit shard=5```

ops-bot: Canary auto-pause triggered: p95 > 4x baseline AND error_rate > 1% -> PAUSED at 15% traffic.

ana: proposal: immediate rollback to last stable release v2026.03.01 for this route. pinning might not address kernel_missing. rollback cost is high but safer if kernel mismatch causes errors.

mike: i prefer pin if kernel_missing is only for quantized path; pin would route to a build that uses fallback kernels. rollback full release would disrupt traffic to other routes.

sara: we can also try a targeted rollback: route embeddings in eu-central to v2026.03.01 while keeping other regions on rc5. small blast radius and faster mitigation.

infra-bot: Suggested actions computed: ["eu-central partial rollback to v2026.03.01","pin route to runtime:v3.13","increase kv cache TTL for shard 5"]

ana: ordering: 1) partial regional rollback for embeddings eu-central 2) monitor p95 + 5xx 3) create postmortem INF-4162. ok?

mike: executing regional rollback now: `PATCH /routing/embeddings?region=eu-central {"version":"v2026.03.01","reason":"canary 15% spike kernel_missing"}`

deploy-bot: routing update applied by mike at 12:18:03Z -> embeddings (eu-central) -> v2026.03.01. audit a-1747776543.

sara: after rollback, p95 back to 125ms in eu-central, 5xx down to 0.2%. kernel_missing warnings ceased.

ops-bot: Canary paused; partial rollback applied. Manual release lead approval required to continue global rollout.

ana: documenting in release-notes: "v2026.03.22-rc5 partial rollback in eu-central for embeddings due to kernel_missing causing p95/502 spike. Investigating quant path and kernel packaging. INF-4162." cc @support

mike: created INF-4162 and linked traces & config diffs.

sara: leaving note on routing config: "regional rollback applied during canary for kernel_missing; revisit quantization CI and kernel bundling."

deploy-bot: deployment state recorded: partial rollback region=eu-central (1747776543).

ana: hold the thread. follow-ups will continue in INF-4162. good triage team. :handshake:
